title: Fixed Point for Some Polynomial Contractions
content: In this paper, we introduce the notion of Kannan polynomial contraction in the setting of metric spaces and establish the existence and uniqueness of fixed points for this class of mappings. Furthermore, we extend the study to b-metric spaces by investigating polynomial contractions and Kannan polynomial contractions in this generalized framework. Sufficient conditions are provided to guarantee the existence and uniqueness of fixed points in b-metric spaces. The obtained results extend several known fixed point theorems from metric spaces to b-metric spaces.
